references.text: The blood of the sacrifice shall be sprinkled on the altar, as described in the instructions for the burnt offering.
The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the incense altar and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the burnt offering altar.
The blood shall be put on the horns of the altar, and the rest shall be poured out at the base of the altar, as is done with the sin offering.

The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the burnt offering altar, and the rest of the blood shall be poured out at the base of the altar.

The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the horns of the burnt offering altar, and the rest of the blood shall be poured out at the base of the altar.
Moses slaughtered the bull, took its blood, and with his finger put it on all around the horns of the altar to cleanse the altar; then he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
The blood of the sin offering shall be put on the horns of the altar, and the rest shall be poured out at the base of the altar.
The Letter to the Hebrews explains how blood was sprinkled on the tabernacle and all the vessels used in its service, and that under the law almost everything is cleansed with blood.
